sentences.text: The genus Huangshanlong contains only one species, Huangshanlong anhuiensis, making it one of three dinosaur genera known from Anhui province.
Huangshanlong is distinguished by unique arm bone proportions, including a humerus where the proximal transverse length is 36% of the total length and the radius is 58% of the humerus length.
Research by Ren et al. (2018) places Huangshanlong as a sister taxon to Anhuilong and Omeisaurus within a specific clade of Mamenchisauridae.
Huangshanlong lived between 174.7 and 161.5 million years ago during the Aalenian to Callovian stages.
